description: CM Yogi Adityanath said UP aims to make Lucknow a leading AI innovation city and support at least 50 world-class AI startups over five years. He also launched HCL IT City’s Phase 2 expansion, involving around Rs 500 crore investment and expected to create about 6,000 direct and indirect jobs.
body_lead: Lucknow, October 6: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath said, "The Uttar Pradesh government's resolve is to establish Lucknow among India's leading AI innovation cities. For this, a strong innovation ecosystem will be developed over the next 5 years, under which the government will extend full support to establish at least 50 world-class AI startups in Lucknow, strengthen them, and help them reach the global market." The Chief Minister also urged HCL Tech to partner in this campaign.
